scope: Instruments issued after 2025-07-08 and up to 2026-11-11 that change Vietnam's preferential (MFN) import duty rates in Annex II (Biểu thuế nhập khẩu ưu đãi) of Decree 26/2023/NĐ-CP, including temporary reductions.
search_method: Official Government portal document listings, paged in full: chinhphu.vn/he-thong-van-ban typegroupid=4 (all Decrees, back to 2019), orggroupid=2 (all Government normative documents, back to Jan 2025) and classid=509 (Government resolutions, back to 2019). Each title was screened for 'thuế nhập khẩu', 'Biểu thuế', '26/2023' and 'xăng'. Every candidate's signed PDF was downloaded from datafiles.chinhphu.vn and read. Cross-checked against the Government Office monthly bulletins of normative documents for Jul, Aug and Sep 2026, and against web searches.

coverage_limits: Decree numbers missing from the official portal listing: 2025 #203, 223, 244, 252, 256, 270, 276, 298, 345; 2026 #8, 10, 11, 12, 107, 111, 124, 126, 130, 149, 173, 194, 195, 226, 270, 282, 370, 380. The Government Office monthly bulletins (datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/8/tcbcvbqpplthang07.2026-bh.signed.pdf, .../2026/9/tcbcvbqpplthang8.2026.bantrinh.signed.pdf, .../2026/10/tcbc-t9-2026.signed.pdf) list every normative instrument for Jul-Sep 2026 and contain no MFN amendment other than Resolutions 34/2026 and 43/2026. In them #282/2026 is a culture decree, #370/2026 is a police-allowance decree withheld from publication, and the July list also skips #270. The other gaps were not individually confirmed. Web searches for decrees amending Decree 26/2023 found no additional instrument.
